## Business Summary
喵喵大业（Stacie Cat Care）provides cat-focused boarding and drop-in care for Vancouver families.
Priority is low-stress handling, daily owner updates, transparent pricing, and clear emergency process.
Public review evidence comes from Rover data (74+ comments, 5.0 rating at extraction time).
